items.summary: Mage OSS through 0.9.80 proceeds with session creation when it encounters an unknown OAuth provider, a session-handling flaw that lets attackers establish sessions illegitimately. Public proof-of-concept exploit code is available, though it is not yet in the CISA KEV catalog.

Misaka Danmu Server through 2.8.9 has an authentication bypass in the unprotected POST /api/ui/config-history/rollback endpoint, letting unauthenticated attackers write arbitrary configuration keys. No public exploit is confirmed yet; patch and monitor.

OpenNMS Meridian and Horizon REST APIs miss an authorization deny rule: Spring Security intercept-url rules compare the HTTP method case-sensitively, so a non-canonical (e.g. lowercase) method token skips authentication entirely. Unauthenticated attackers can read inventory and create, modify, or delete resources, including injecting events to fake or suppress alarms.

iFlytek astron-agent before 1.1.2 defaults its workflow code-node path to an unsandboxed LocalExecutor that exposes full Python builtins. An authenticated low-privilege tenant can execute code as root in the core-workflow container and use shared credentials to read or modify other tenants' data.

Apache CXF's STSTokenValidator and Security Token Service cached validated tokens under a non-cryptographic 32-bit hash and treated a cache hit as proof of validation. An attacker can craft a token whose hash collides with a cached entry and be accepted without password or signature verification, authenticating as another user.
